app.name: DnD Manager
app.tagline: Campaigns, characters, and a table that remembers.
auth.register.title: Create an account
auth.login.title: Log in
error.username.chars: Username may contain letters, numbers, and underscores.
error.password.length: Password must be at least 8 characters.
error.forbidden: You do not have access to this page.
error.campaign.name: Campaign name is required.
error.already.member: You are already in this campaign.
error.character.name: Character name is required.
error.not.member: Join the campaign before creating a character.
landing.body: Register, start a campaign, share an invite code, and create a character with the wizard.
campaign.create.title: Create a campaign
campaign.name: Campaign name
campaign.join.title: Join a campaign
campaign.join.lead: Ask the DM for the invite code.
campaign.empty.characters: No characters in this campaign yet.
campaign.you.dm: You are the Dungeon Master of this campaign.
campaign.you.player: You are a Player in this campaign.
campaign.treasury.note: Souls are the campaign pool. Party gold is the sum of gold held by characters.
character.create.title: Create a character
character.create.lead: Name, race, background, class, then assign the standard array. Confirm to create the sheet.
character.name: Character name
character.abilities.note: Score and modifier on top; saving throw below the line.
character.combat.note: Click − / + on HP or temp HP to open a modal. Damage spends stacked temp HP first, then current HP. Equipped resistance halves (round down), immunity zeros, vulnerability doubles. Healing does not restore temp HP. Temp HP from different statuses stack. AC and speed include unarmored features, worn armor/shield, and statuses.
character.combat.death.note: Marked when you are at 0 hit points. They clear when you regain HP.
character.combat.effects.empty: No spell effects or conditions right now.
character.status.note: Temporary effects from spells, potions, and abilities. Temp HP from different sources stacks (house rule). Recasting the same spell refreshes that row.
character.status.duration_turns.hint: 0 = not turn-limited. Damage ticks at the start of that creature’s turn; duration drops at the end of their turn.
error.status.name: Give the status a name or pick a catalog condition.
character.levelup.title: Level up
character.levelup.asi.lead: You gain +2. Put both points in one score or split +1/+1.
character.levelup.asi.todo: Feat picker is not available yet.
character.levelup.preview.wait: Choose the remaining options to see a preview.
wizard.step1.title: Identity
wizard.step1.lead: Name your character and pick a race and background.
wizard.step2.title: Class
wizard.step2.lead: Subclass is required only when this class level grants it.
wizard.step3.title: Ability scores
wizard.step3.lead: Assign 15, 14, 13, 12, 10, and 8 once each. Bonuses from earlier steps are shown on the totals.
wizard.step4.title: Confirm
wizard.step4.lead: Check the sheet, then create the character in this campaign.
wizard.subclass.later: This class chooses a subclass at class level
wizard.subclass.pickclass: Choose a class to see subclass options.
wizard.assign.hint: Each standard-array value may be used once.
error.wizard.subclass: Choose a subclass for this class level.
error.wizard.array: Assign each of 15, 14, 13, 12, 10, and 8 exactly once.
error.wizard.hp: Enter a hit-die roll from 1 up to the die size.
character.skills.note: Bonus is ability modifier plus proficiency (and expertise). Equipped skill proficiency overlays while worn; numeric item bonuses to skills/saves are still TODO.
character.saves.note: Class grants are applied automatically; you can still toggle proficiency.
character.checks.dm_readonly: Dungeon Masters can view bonuses but cannot roll checks.
admin.title: Admin
admin.body: Logs, system values, and catalog editors will live here.
character.resources.note: Each pool is tracked separately. Pact magic never mixes with spell slots.
character.resources.none: No class resources on this sheet.
character.spells.prepared.note: Prepared spells plus at-will grants from equipped items.
character.spells.prepared.empty: No spells prepared. Mark them on the learned list while editing.
character.spells.learned.note: Add and remove spells while editing. Changing prepared spells on a long rest is not implemented yet.
character.spells.pact_upcast: Warlock pact slots are always this level:
character.spells.dm_readonly: Dungeon Masters can view spells but cannot use them.
character.weapon.dm_readonly: Dungeon Masters can view attack formulas but cannot roll.
error.weapon.formula: This weapon has no rollable attack formula.
error.resource.empty: Not enough of that resource remains.
error.spell.not_learned: That spell is not on this character.
error.spell.formula: This spell has no rollable formula.
error.item.slot_required: Choose a slot to equip this item.
error.item.missing: That item is not on this character.
error.hp.amount: Enter an amount of at least 1.
character.inventory.note: Wearable slots are exclusive. Attunement happens on equip (max 3). Temporary HP from items is not applied until you configure it.
character.inventory.type.note: Pick a type, then a PHB base (or jewelry slot), then common or magic.
character.inventory.base.search.note: Pick a PHB base weapon, then common (+N) or magic (one-stat features).
character.inventory.base.search.note.wea: Pick a PHB base weapon, then common (+N) or magic (one-stat features).
character.inventory.base.search.note.arm: Pick a PHB armor or shield, then common (+AC) or magic.
character.inventory.base.search.note.jew: Pick a slot base (ring, neck, cloak…), then common (+AC) or magic.
character.inventory.rarity.note: Common applies an optional +N to attack and damage. Magic starts with the base properties so you can attach Vorpal, crit, personality…
character.inventory.rarity.note.weapon: Common applies an optional +N to attack and damage. Magic starts with the base properties so you can attach Vorpal, crit, personality…
character.inventory.rarity.note.armor: Common applies an optional +N to AC. Magic starts with stealth/heavy/shield tags so you can attach grants.
character.inventory.rarity.note.jewelry: Common applies an optional +N to AC (ring of protection style). Magic is an empty feature list for pickers and pasted 5e14 URLs.
character.inventory.search.note: Search consumables, then preview and add.
character.gold.hint: Gold is on the character, not an inventory item. The DM can also change it.
character.souls.hint: Souls are shared by the campaign. The pool cannot go above the cap.
error.souls.cap: Souls cap must be at least 1.
character.item.stub.note: This item is not in the SRD. Open the 5e14 page and add features yourself.
character.item.plus_n.note: Smith/loot bonus. Stored as two features (atk_bonus and dmg_bonus).
character.spells.item_at_will: Granted by an equipped item. Cast does not spend a slot (at-will; no dawn/d6 recharge).
character.hp.damage.title: Damage
character.hp.heal.title: Heal
character.hp.temp_down.title: Reduce temporary HP
character.hp.temp_up.title: Add temporary HP
character.hp.damage.hint: Temp HP absorbs first. Equipped resistance, immunity, and vulnerability apply.
character.hp.heal.hint: Healing cannot go above max HP and does not restore temporary HP.
character.hp.temp.hint: Adds to or spends the stacked temp HP pool. No damage type.
character.item.desc.en_fallback: Russian article text is not stored (no HTML scrape). English SRD is shown; open 5e14 for the Russian page.
character.item.features.note: Each feature is one stat and a value. Generic bonuses first, then magic items and spells. Paste a 5e14 URL for unknown rows.
character.item.features.name: Name
character.item.features.search.empty: No matching features, items, or spells.
character.item.slot.head: Head
battle.title: Battle
battle.none.dm: Start an encounter from the campaign page.
battle.setup.monsters.note: Search the 2014 catalog. Quantity splits into one row per creature.
battle.add.monsters.note: Summons and reinforcements. Each new monster rolls 1d20+DEX modifier and joins the current turn order.
battle.added.empty: No monsters yet. Search and add at least one, or continue with player characters only.
battle.setup.init.note: IRL number, per-row Auto-calculate, or Auto-calculate all monsters (1d20+DEX modifier). Higher goes first; DEX score breaks ties.
battle.death_save.title: Death saving throw
battle.death_save.note: IRL 1d20. 10 or higher is a success. Three failures and the character dies.
battle.monster.stub.note: Not in the 2014 SRD. Open 5e14 for the stat block; added with 1 HP so you can edit it.
battle.stats.note: Dead, alive, and escaped counts. Generate loot from dead monsters (not PCs, companions, or summons).
battle.loot.dm.note: Gold is an unassigned pile — give it to characters from their sheets. Souls go to the campaign pool once.
battle.loot.search.note: Search the catalog, preview, then add a loot row (not granted to a PC).
battle.loot.quest.note: A unique or story item with a name only. No catalog id.
battle.loot.quest.name: Name
error.loot.name: Enter a quest item name.
battle.player.note: You see the turn order, player hit points, and non-hidden player statuses. Monster hit points, ability scores, resistances, and monster statuses stay with the DM. Hidden curses are DM-only.
battle.edit.title: Edit stats
battle.edit.note: Applies to every copy of this monster in the fight.
battle.edit.dex.hint: Initiative is 1d20 plus the DEX modifier from this score.
battle.edit.scores.hint: Saves use the ability modifier (no proficiency bonus unless the catalog snapshot already had a save flag). Initiative still uses DEX.
error.battle.qty: Add between 1 and 20 of a monster.
error.battle.status: That step is not available now.
error.battle.unit: That creature is not in this fight.
error.battle.not_dying: Death saves are only for knocked-out player characters.
error.battle.stats: HP must be at least 1 (current cannot exceed max). AC 0–40, ability scores 1–30.
character.companions.add.note: Add is only available while this character qualifies (Beast Master, Find Familiar / Pact of the Chain, or an equipped companion item).
character.companion.name: Name
character.companion.search.beast: Wolf, hawk… CR 1/4 Medium or smaller
battle.summon.note: Battle-only. Uses this character’s conjure spell; creatures vanish when the fight ends.
battle.summon.done: Summoned into the current order, after the caster.
error.companion.gate: This character cannot add that companion.
error.companion.limit: That companion slot is already filled.
error.companion.kind: That creature does not match this companion type.
error.companion.cr: Beast Master companions must be beasts, Medium or smaller, CR 1/4 or lower.
error.companion.spell: That character cannot cast this conjure spell.
character.mutation.part.player: The player chooses the body part.
character.mutation.part.head: Head
character.mutation.attack.name: Attack name
character.mutation.feature.hint: Only the fields for the chosen feature are used. One mutation per body part; a new one replaces the old.
error.character.dead.locked: Only Revive can remove the Dead status.
error.mutation.type: Choose a creature type and size.
error.mutation.cr: Challenge rating is out of range.
